definitions.gloss: to start running; to break into a run
definitions.explanation: To suddenly begin running. Describes the moment when someone transitions from standing or walking into a running motion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{走|はし}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The children broke into a run toward the schoolyard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なったら→なる：01970_naru⟧{走|はし}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: When the light turned green, I started running.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{走|はし}り{出|だ}して⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えなく→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He suddenly started running and disappeared from sight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦リード→リード：11601_riido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}って→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧{走|はし}り{出|だ}したので、⟦{転|ころ}び→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The dog pulled the leash and started running, and I nearly fell over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧そう⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気|き}づいて→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧、⟦{慌|あわ}てて→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧{走|はし}り{出|だ}したが、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: I realized I was going to be late and frantically broke into a run, but I still missed the train.

notes:
ASPECT: 〜{出|だ}す marks the onset of the motion, so {走|はし}り{出|だ}す normally appears in the past ({走|はし}り{出|だ}した) or in て-form leading into what happened next. For running that is under way, use ⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧.

FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to begin).

The 〜{出|だ}す pattern indicates the beginning of an action. With motion verbs it emphasizes the moment of transition into that motion, often abruptly and without warning.

SIMILAR COMPOUND VERBS:
・{歩|ある}き{出|だ}す - to start walking
・{泳|およ}ぎ{出|だ}す - to start swimming
・⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}す→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧ - to jump/rush out
・⟦{笑|わら}い{出|だ}す→笑い出す：06678_waraidasu⟧ - to start laughing
・⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}す→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧ - to start crying

USAGE NOTE:
{走|はし}り{出|だ}す focuses on the moment of starting to run; {走|はし}り{出|で}る (different reading of the second element) means to run out of a place.
